name: Thuluk's Marvelous Axes
desc1: The first thing you notice as you enter the room is a massively-built
desc2: dwarf, furiously hammering a glowing red bar of metal into the flat
desc3: head of an axe. His braided beard hangs down over his broad, bare
desc4: chest, and is tucked into his belt. When he hears the door open, he
desc5: looks up and demands "What do YOU want?" with an emphatic snarl. Axes,
desc6: polearms, and spears of all types are hung about the room on racks.
desc7: You can exit this shop to the east, onto a broad street.
